definitions.explanation: To go on without stopping, to persist over time. An intransitive verb describing something that keeps happening or existing.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{三日間|みっかかん}{続|つづ}きました。
examples.english: The rain continued for three days.

examples.japanese: この{道|みち}は{駅|えき}まで{続|つづ}いています。
examples.english: This road continues to the station.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}は{明日|あした}に{続|つづ}きます。
{会議|かいぎ}は{午後|ごご}まで{続|つづ}いて、とても{疲|つか}れました。
examples.english: The meeting continued until the afternoon, and I got very tired.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}は{何年|なんねん}も{続|つづ}いていますが、まだ{解決|かいけつ}していません。
examples.english: This problem has continued for years, but it still hasn't been resolved.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {続|つづ}ける (transitive). Pattern: Xが{続|つづ}く (X continues).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state. {続|つづ}いている = 'is continuing' (ongoing state).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{雨|あめ}が{続|つづ}く (rain continues)
・{話|はなし}が{続|つづ}く (story continues)
・{道|みち}が{続|つづ}く (road continues)
・{続|つづ}きを{読|よ}む (read the continuation)

PAIR: {続|つづ}ける (transitive) - {勉強|べんきょう}を{続|つづ}ける (continue studying). Noun: {続|つづ}き (continuation).
